source_findings.exit: SMT inclusion, nullified output root, exact total/capacity deltas, 180-epoch silence delay, and canonical secp lock derived from leaf pubkey are checked by the force-exit script.
source_findings.data_availability: Checkpoint witnesses publish 56-byte post-state records per touched leaf; user reconstruction requires checkpoint history and root comparison.
source_findings.exit_witness: 8,249-byte full-depth proof format in the deployed force-exit documentation.
source_findings.small_balance: Unilateral standalone L1 payout is subject to approximately 61 CKB occupied-capacity floor. Smaller egress relies on atomic swap/Fiber liquidity; not an independent unilateral exit.
source_findings.contention: Force exits mutate one shared anchor outpoint; upstream describes sharding/batching as throughput mitigation.
source_findings.upstream_tests: Trade executed 49 pinned default-feature host STF tests and 24 CKB-VM tests from the upstream force-exit, withdrawal, and anchor suites with unchanged test sources and a disclosed Zig RISC-V adapter.

execution_blocker: Private devnet lifecycle, genuine timeout, chain-published DA reconstruction, and deployment identity are not tested.

upstream_host_stf_test.features: Cargo defaults only; feature-gated tests with zero selected tests are not counted as validated

contract_build_attempts.reason: no_std CKB contract requires a RISC-V target; host build reports missing panic_handler
ckb-std C build cannot find riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc; no compiler substitution or feature weakening

contract_build.feature_set: default; no features removed or added
contract_build.adaptation: Temporary wrapper maps --target=riscv64 to riscv64-freestanding and the upstream C ISA rv64imc_zba_zbb_zbc_zbs to Zig equivalent -mcpu=baseline_rv64-a-f-d+zba+zbb+zbc+zbs -mabi=lp64. ELF attributes were checked after build; F/D are disabled in C objects. This still differs from upstream CI clang.
contract_build.binary_format: ELF 64-bit executable, UCB RISC-V, RVC, soft-float ABI, statically linked, stripped; ELF arch rv64imac_zba_zbb_zbc_zbs (no F/D).
contract_build.compiler_adapter_debugging: An initial generic Zig baseline produced a binary with F/D attributes and passed tests; inspection found this exceeded the upstream C ISA. A cached rebuild did not pick up wrapper changes, so the runner was changed to clean first. The final clean build has no F/D attributes and its exact binary hash is recorded.

ckb_vm_test_suites.harness: upstream ckb-testtool 0.13.2; tests run unchanged against the locally built RISC-V contract
